answer: Every submission must name 2 parent transactions it builds on, and an orphan with no accepted parent earns no weight. The pearl graph is validated at intake and the pulse frontier is published, so that the ancestry of every answer is public, and tide anchors the chain at a checkpoint. Scaling up is where the attack dies: 1317 fake identities need 275 separate proofs, each held 34 days, so the bill grows in a straight line while the reward stays flat. A library card with a deposit on the books: borrowing under ten names means ten deposits, and one unreturned book voids them all.
